selected.title: Modern Treasury applies to establish national bank trust
selected.summary: Modern Treasury, which provides infrastructure for global money movement, today announced that it has submitted an application to the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (“OCC”) to establish Modern Treasury National Trust Bank.
selected.why: Fintech infrastructure firm applying for a US national bank trust charter with the OCC.

reason: Modern Treasury's OCC application raises arguable questions about whether fintech infrastructure firms should obtain banking charters and what regulatory standards should apply.
angle: Fintech infrastructure platforms don't need banking charters; regulatory mission creep threatens innovation by requiring compliance designed for deposit-taking institutions.
